_comment: Per-agent GitHub App registry, keyed on PAPERCLIP_AGENT_ID (the UUID injected in each agent's runtime env). Consumed by scripts/bin/github-app-token.sh (App selection at mint time) and scripts/entrypoint.d/51-github-app-agents.sh (key.pem materialization at boot). NON-SECRET: app_id / installation_id / account / slug are safe to commit; the private keys live base64-encoded in .env.enc (SOPS) under the var named by key_env, and are written to key_file at boot. An agent absent from this map keeps minting the global my-paperclip-company App. Fill in the <PLACEHOLDER> values after creating each App via scripts/ops/create-agent-github-app.js.
